name: StoreSEO
summary: SEO suite for Shopify: bulk meta titles and descriptions, image compression and alt text, JSON-LD schema, sitemap submission, instant indexing requests and Search Console reporting, with AI credits for generated copy.
best_for: Shopify stores with a few hundred products and no in-house SEO help, who want metadata, schema, alt text and indexing handled in bulk and reported against Search Console
skip_if: you have fewer than 25 products, in which case the free tier is the whole product, or you expect an app to fix a demand problem rather than a metadata one
honest_knock: Know what an SEO app can and cannot do before you buy any tier. This one fixes the mechanical layer well — meta titles and descriptions in bulk, alt text, compressed images, JSON-LD, sitemaps, indexing requests — and none of that creates demand for products nobody is searching for. It is maintenance, not marketing, and on a catalogue of 25 products the free tier already does most of it. Two specifics worth a raised eyebrow. The pricing gap between Essential at $39.99 for 250 products and Advanced at $249.99 for 10,000 is filled by a $99.99 Growth plan. That plan lives on the vendor's own site but not on the App Store listing our link points to, which is a strange place to hide a tier. And the AEO/GEO features — the LLMs.txt generator, the Agents.md editor, the separate “agentic” ranking — are a bet, not a channel. No major search or AI vendor has committed to reading llms.txt, so treat those numbers as a hypothesis you are testing rather than traffic you are buying.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/storeseo, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-28) Free Forever covers 25 products with SEO scoring, 200 AI credits, 25 image optimisations, up to 5 tracked keywords, an LLMs.txt generator and Agents.md editor, an SEO migrator, alt-text optimisation and 24/7 chat support. Paid tiers are Lite $14.99, Essential $39.99 and Advanced $249.99 a month, each with a 7-day free trial. Lite covers 100 products, 500 image optimisations and 1,000 AI credits and adds one-click schema markup, instant indexing requests, Google Analytics and Search Console and automatic sitemap submission. Essential covers 250 products, 2,000 images and 5,000 credits. Advanced covers 10,000 products, 50,000 images, 50,000 credits and adds multilingual SEO. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Worth knowing: storeseo.com sells a Growth plan at $99.99 a month (1,000 products, 5,000 images, 12,500 AI credits, 200 keywords) that does not appear on the App Store listing at all, and also sells credit top-ups from $10 for 5,000 credits, $50 for 25,000 and $100 for 50,000. Rating 5.0 from 753 App Store reviews on 28 September 2026 (751 on 19 September, 674 on 19 August). Developer Storeware, Milton, Delaware; the app launched 19 October 2021 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge.
